description: This file defines the Drupal entity class 'MenuLinkContent' for managing custom menu link content, including properties, methods for URL handling, plugin definition, lifecycle hooks, and database field definitions.

classes.name: MenuLinkContent
classes.description: Defines the entity class for custom menu links, including properties, lifecycle methods, and plugin definitions.

methods.name: setInsidePlugin
methods.description: Sets the internal flag indicating the entity is wrapped in a plugin instance.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the menu link.

methods.name: getUrlObject
methods.description: Retrieves the URL object for the menu link, sanitizing attributes if present.

methods.name: getMenuName
methods.description: Returns the menu name associated with the link.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the menu link.

methods.name: getPluginId
methods.description: Generates a unique plugin ID for the menu link.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the menu link is enabled.

methods.name: isExpanded
methods.description: Checks if the menu link is expanded.

methods.name: getParentId
methods.description: Returns the parent plugin ID, or empty string if none.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the menu link for ordering.

methods.name: getPluginDefinition
methods.description: Builds and returns the plugin definition array for the menu link.

methods.name: preCreate
methods.description: Prepares default values before creating a new entity.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Performs actions before saving, such as rediscovery flag setting.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Updates the menu link definition after saving the entity.

methods.name: preDelete
methods.description: Handles cleanup before deleting entities, including removing definitions and reattaching children.

methods.name: baseFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Defines the base fields for the entity, including ID, UUID, title, description, link, status, hierarchy, and revision info.

methods.name: requiresRediscovery
methods.description: Checks if the link requires rediscovery.

methods.name: setRequiresRediscovery
methods.description: Sets the rediscovery flag for the link.
